notes: Preliminary N-14 8C (filed 2021-10-08) for the reorganization of MYJ into MUJ. The meeting date, record date and expected closing are bracketed placeholders ('[●]'); expected_close reads 'sometime during the [●] quarter of [●]', so it is left null. The Target Fund's VRDP Shares are also exchanged one-for-one for new Acquiring Fund VRDP Shares; security_class records common because the joint proxy/prospectus is for common shareholders. 'other' condition = third-party consents incl. the VRDP liquidity provider. The terms-of-agreement section (tax opinion, registration, etc.) lies after the excerpt cut, so no further conditions are recorded. n_targets is counted from the single named target (not a stated number). One passage names the acquirer 'BlackRock MuniHoldings Quality Fund, Inc.' (ticker MUJ) — apparently a drafting slip; the name used elsewhere is 'BlackRock MuniHoldings New Jersey Quality Fund, Inc.'. Collar not stated.
